function.name: get_time
function.description: Return the current local time on the Android phone.

function.name: get_date
function.description: Return today's local date on the Android phone.

function.name: open_app
function.description: Open an installed Android app by the name the user says, such as Telegram, YouTube or Chrome.

function.name: open_settings
function.description: Open Android settings. Choose the named section: wifi, bluetooth, sound, display, accessibility, or general.

function.name: open_web
function.description: Open a website URL or search the web for the user's target.

function.name: calculate
function.description: Calculate a simple arithmetic expression such as 12+7, 20/4, 5*8 or 10-3.

function.name: save_note
function.description: Save a short note locally on this device.

function.name: set_timer_seconds
function.description: Open the Android timer UI for a duration stated in seconds.

function.name: set_timer_minutes
function.description: Open the Android timer UI for a duration stated in minutes.

function.name: set_timer_hours
function.description: Open the Android timer UI for a duration stated in hours.

function.name: volume_up
function.description: Increase the current Android media volume.

function.name: volume_down
function.description: Decrease the current Android media volume.

function.name: volume_mute
function.description: Toggle Android media volume mute.

function.name: go_back
function.description: Navigate back in the current Android app using the accessibility service.

function.name: go_home
function.description: Go to the Android home screen using the accessibility service.

function.name: open_recents
function.description: Open Android recent apps using the accessibility service.

function.name: lock_screen
function.description: Lock the Android screen using the accessibility service.

function.name: open_accessibility_settings
function.description: Open Android accessibility settings so the user can enable Mini-UNA system controls.

function.name: play_music
function.description: Play music: open the user's music app (Spotify, Yandex Music, YouTube Music or system player) and start playback. Use for requests like play music, turn on music. Optional playlist name is passed to the NeonWave player.

function.name: media_play_pause
function.description: Toggle play/pause for the currently playing media.

function.name: media_next
function.description: Skip to the next media track.

function.name: media_previous
function.description: Go back to the previous media track.

function.name: set_alarm
function.description: Set an Android alarm clock. Hour is 0-23, minutes 0-59. Days is an optional list of Calendar day constants (1=Sunday..7=Saturday); omit for a daily alarm.

function.name: dismiss_alarm
function.description: The user wants to cancel or turn off an alarm. There is no direct API, explain that alarms are managed in the Clock app.

function.name: volume_percent
function.description: Set Android media volume to a percentage from 0 to 100.

function.name: start_listening
function.description: Turn on always-on hotword listening for the name Yuna: the assistant will react to voice commands even with the app minimized.

function.name: stop_listening
function.description: Turn off always-on hotword listening.

function.name: remind
function.description: Set a reminder: notify with the given text after the given number of seconds.

function.name: screen_read
function.description: Read back the text currently visible on the Android screen. Use when the user asks what is on the screen.

function.name: read_notifications
function.description: Read back the most recent Android notifications.

function.name: follow_notifications
function.description: Start announcing new notifications from the named app, such as Telegram or WhatsApp.

function.name: unfollow_notifications
function.description: Stop announcing notifications from the named app.

function.name: youtube_search
function.description: Search YouTube for videos matching the user's query and open the results.

function.name: send_telegram
function.description: Share the given text to Telegram via the system share sheet.

function.name: media_pause
function.description: Pause the currently playing media (explicit stop, never toggles).

function.name: dismiss_alarm
function.description: Turn off an alarm clock. Hour is 0-23, minutes 0-59. snooze_minutes postpones it instead of turning off.

function.name: cancel_timer
function.description: Dismiss the currently running timer.

function.name: wifi_panel
function.description: Open the system Wi-Fi settings panel with a switch.

function.name: bluetooth_panel
function.description: Open the system Bluetooth settings panel with a switch.
